text.en: Pet owners widely praise the clinical team, veterinary nurses, and receptionists for their patient and reassuring guidance during emergencies. Multiple reviewers mention that clinicians explain necessary treatments clearly and follow up by telephone after discharge, though one client felt a consultation lacked empathy.

Reviewers note that both dogs and cats are handled gently during examinations, physical therapy, and urgent consultations. Pet owners appreciate being allowed in the consultation room throughout the evaluation, which helps keep nervous animals calm during diagnostic checks and routine assessments.

Feedback regarding medical fees is varied among clients visiting the hospital. Several pet owners note that itemised cost estimates were provided in advance and found prices fair for emergency support, whereas another visitor felt that intensive surgical procedures were prohibitively expensive.

q.en: Does the centre accept emergency walk-in visits?

a.en: Yes, pet owners confirm that the facility accommodates urgent arrivals and weekend emergencies, though wait times can fluctuate.

q.en: Are pet owners permitted in exam rooms during visits?

a.en: Yes, clients appreciate being able to remain with their dogs throughout clinical consultations and examinations.

q.en: Does the practice provide physical rehabilitation services?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention water treadmill sessions and structured physical therapy guided by trained rehabilitation staff.

q.en: Are cost estimates discussed before veterinary treatment?

a.en: Yes, clients report that staff outline treatment choices and present itemised price breakdowns prior to proceeding with care.
